name: Mount Josephine
summary: Cook County, MN: a ladder lookout with lattice legs on Hat Point near Grand Portage; listed as gone, but its stone base remains near the summit trail.
design: Ladder tower with unusual lattice-style legs; also called the Grand Portage lookout
status_note: FFLA lists it as gone; two hiking accounts describe a stone base and metal parts at the summit

access.note: Hiking trail from County Road 17 to the former tower site; Superior Hiking places the mountain within the Grand Portage Reservation; no closure or permit found in the sources read

visit.drive_up: Small parking area on the north side of County Road 17, about 2.4 km east of the village of Grand Portage, marked by a small sign
visit.trail_note: About 400 m along a two-track road, then a trail into the woods climbs about 200 m to the former tower site; one visitor says the trailheads are unmarked and the only sign on the route is about half a mile in
